scope: Offline quote-quality gate and paper fill prevention; no claim of broker execution or complete live auction-state coverage.
implemented: Fail-closed checks for malformed, non-positive, crossed, locked, zero-depth, stale/future-stamped, wide-spread and zero-volume quote evidence.
Circuit/halt indicators, positive circuit-band touches, auction flags/phases when supplied, and configured per-instrument freeze quantities block simulated execution.
Quality rejections retain quote event digests and reason codes; if all candidate quotes fail, the paper intent resolves to no-trade without spread interpolation.
Quality thresholds and configured freeze limits are frozen into the execution-model digest; an accepted no-fill order is correctly canceled in the paper account bridge.

limitations: Kite REST quote snapshots do not establish auction phase; auction gating applies only when an upstream normalized source supplies auction state. A trusted session/auction state source is not connected.

The default quote age is a model threshold, but Kite timestamp semantics can reflect last trade rather than depth capture; source-specific age policy and empirical freshness validation remain incomplete.
Configured freeze quantities are not yet automatically resolved from the effective-dated instrument/order-rule master for all symbols; do not claim full freeze-limit coverage without that wiring.
Displayed top-of-book paper fills remain simulated and do not establish queue position, depth evolution, broker fills, or live execution quality.
